promptDisplayMode.desc: Fixed height or auto height with draggable resize support

promptHighlight.desc: Automatically colorize prompt display according to the Stable Diffusion syntax rules
promptHighlight.title: Prompt Syntax Highlighting

defaultWidth.desc: Default width of the sidebar when starting
defaultWidth.title: Default Width

displayMode.desc: Fixed as grid mode for constant display, auto-expand when the mouse moves to the side in floating mode
displayMode.title: Display Mode

enable.desc: Enable the quick setting sidebar on the left side
enable.title: Enable

reduceAnimation.desc: Reduce the blur effect and background flow color, which can improve smoothness and save CPU usage
reduceAnimation.title: Reduce Animation

splitPreviewer.desc: Put the prompt input box on the left and the generate button on the right, ensuring that the generated image is always displayed at the top when scrolling
splitPreviewer.title: Split Previewer

svgIcons.desc: Replace all Emoji icons in stable diffusion webui with SVG icons globally
svgIcons.title: SVG Icons

commandPalette.title: Command palette
commandPalette.desc: Press Ctrl+K (⌘K on Mac) to search and run actions, tabs, samplers, checkpoints, LoRAs, presets, history and WebUI settings

history.title: Generation history
history.desc: Keep every txt2img and img2img result with its parameters and a thumbnail, stored in the extension's lobe_data folder

presets.title: Parameter presets
presets.desc: A Presets panel in the left sidebar to save and apply sampler, steps, CFG, size and hires fix settings

loraTools.title: LoRA card tools
loraTools.desc: Favorites, a weight per LoRA, model family badges, trigger words and filters on LoRA cards

tabProgress.title: Progress on tab icon
tabProgress.desc: A progress ring on the tab icon while generating, and a check mark when a background tab finishes

notification.title: Desktop notification
notification.desc: Notify when a generation finishes while the page is in the background (the browser asks for permission)

localAssets.title: Local assets
localAssets.desc: Load the logo, icons and fonts from the extension instead of a CDN, so the theme works without internet access

imageButtonsTop.title: Image buttons under Generate
imageButtonsTop.desc: Moves the image buttons (open folder, save, zip, send to img2img, inpaint, extras...) from under the gallery to right under Generate / Interrupt / Skip

sizeTools.title: Aspect ratios and suggested settings
sizeTools.desc: Under Width and Height: aspect ratios at a base size that follows the model, a ratio lock, and steps / CFG scale suited to the loaded model

cornerStyle.desc: Corners of buttons, fields, panels and cards
cornerStyle.title: Corners

density.desc: Compact tightens tabs, accordions, fields and spacing so more fits on screen
density.title: Density

surfaceStyle.desc: Flat: plain panels. Glass: frosted, translucent header and sidebars. Elevated: cards with soft shadows
surfaceStyle.title: Surfaces

fontFamily.desc: Interface font. All are bundled, so they work offline; Be Vietnam Pro is drawn for Vietnamese
fontFamily.title: Font

sidebarSwap.desc: Quick Setting on the right, Extra Network on the left
sidebarSwap.title: Swap sidebars

accordionMode.desc: One at a time: opening an accordion folds the others next to it. Folding never switches an extension off
accordionMode.title: Accordions

systemMonitor.desc: CPU, RAM, GPU load, VRAM, temperature and disk under the quick settings
systemMonitor.title: System monitor
